title: 信息日报 2026-07-26

headline.title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5 模型，编程与安全获重大升级
headline.summary: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5，定位为接近 Claude Fable 5 前沿智能的“思考型”模型，价格仅为其一半。在长周期代理编码、多文件重构、端到端功能实现方面表现优异，且成为最难被提示注入的模型之一。
headline.summary_en: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5, described as a thoughtful and proactive model approaching the frontier intelligence of Claude Fable 5 at half the price. It excels at long-horizon agentic coding, multi-file refactors, and end-to-end feature work, while being the least prompt injectable model yet.
headline.reason: Claude Opus 5 的发布在 AI 开发社区引起广泛关注，其性能和安全改进将对未来的 AI 应用和代理开发产生重要影响，符合 AI 与大模型版面核心关注。
headline.reason_en: The release of Claude Opus 5 has generated significant buzz in the AI developer community; its performance and safety improvements will have a major impact on future AI applications and agent development, aligning with the core focus of the AI & LLMs section.
